skills.name: Handle whole numbers
skills.definition: Identify and separate the whole number part from the fraction part of a mixed number or whole number, perform subtraction on the whole number parts, and combine the resulting whole number with the fraction part to form the final answer.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator (LCD) of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator and write the result as a fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: Recognize that the fraction part of the result is negative, and perform the borrowing operation: reduce the whole part by 1, add the denominator to the numerator of the minuend's fraction, then subtract the subtrahend's fraction again; repeat if necessary.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.
